βίηφί: βίη — force, might, violence; instrumental case in -φι (= dat. βίῃ): ’in might’
γάστρην: γαστήρ — belly, paunch (of a cauldron); fem. acc. sg., Ionic (= Attic γαστέρα)
γλαφυρῷ: γλαφυρός — hollow, hollowed out; masc./neut. dat. sg.
γοῶντες: γοάω — wail, lament; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’lamenting’
δαιδαλέου: δαιδάλεος — skilfully wrought, cunningly made; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic δαιδαλοῦ)
δαῖον: δαίω — kindle, set alight; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they kindled’
εἰνάετες: εἰνάετες — for nine years; adv. (εἰνά- epic by-form of ἐννέα ’nine’ + -ετες ’years’), cf. ἑξάετες, πεντάετές in this same part
εὐρυνόμη: Εὐρυνόμη — Eurynome, the housekeeper of Odysseus’s house; fem. nom. sg. · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’Eurynome!’
ζέσσεν: ζέω — boil, seethe; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, double σσ metrical, movable ν (= Attic ἔζεσε(ν)): ’boiled’, intransitive
θέμενος: τίθημι — put, place; mid. also ’convene (an assembly)’; aor. mid. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having convened’
θέντες: τίθημι — put, place; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having placed’
θέρμετο: θέρμω — heat, warm; impf. 3 sg. pass. (= Attic ἐθερμαίνετο): ’was growing hot’
θαμίζεις: θαμίζω — come often, be a frequent visitor; pres. 2 sg. act., negated by οὔ τι: ’you were no frequent visitor’
θαρσύνων: θαρσύνω — encourage, hearten; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’heartening’
καλή: καλός — fine, fair; fem. nom. sg.
καλοῦ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with θρόνου: ’of the fine (chair)’
κόπτε: κόπτω — strike, hammer; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκοπτε)
ληΐδος: ληΐς — booty, spoil; fem. gen. sg., Ionic ληΐς (= Attic λεία)
λοετροχόον: λοετροχόος — pouring bath-water, for bath-water; adj., masc. acc. sg. (Attic λουτροχόος): ’for heating the bath’
μετεφώνεε: μεταφωνέω — speak among, address; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic μετεφώνει)
ξείνια: ξείνιος (Attic ξένιος) — of or for a guest; τὰ ξείνια as noun, gifts and entertainment due to a guest; neut. nom./acc. pl.
προμολοῦσα: προβλώσκω — come forward, go forth; aor. 2 part. fem. nom. sg.
σοῖο: σός — your, yours; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic σοῦ)
στῆσαι: ἵστημι — set, stand up; aor. inf. act., transitive: ’to set up’
σφεων: σφεῖς — they; epic gen. pl. pron. σφέων/σφεων: ’of them’
τρίποδα: τρίπους — tripod, three-footed cauldron-stand; masc. acc. sg.
φῆν: φημί — say, assert; impf. 1 sg., uncontracted (= ἔφην)
χέουσαι: χέω — pour, shed; pres. part. act. fem. nom. pl.
ἀλείφατος: ἄλειφαρ — oil, unguent; neut. gen. sg.
ἀπάξειν: ἀπάγω — lead away, take home; fut. inf. act.
ἀψορρόου: ἀψόρροος — back-flowing; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀψόρρου), of Oceanus
ἄμφεπε: ἀμφέπω — busy oneself about, tend, play about; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἤμφεπε): ’was busy about’
ἐνεῖκαι: φέρω — bring, carry; aor. inf. act., epic -αι (= Attic ἐνεγκεῖν): ’to bring’
ἐννεώροιο: ἐννέωρος — nine years old, of nine seasons; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἐϋσταθέος: ἐϋσταθής — well-standing, firmly built; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -έος (= Attic -οῦς)
ἔκβαλον: ἐκβάλλω — throw out, cast away; aor. 1 sg. (2nd aor.), augmented: ’I threw away’ · also aor. 3 pl.: ’they threw out’
ἔμμεν: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic ἔμμεν(αι) (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔχεαν: χέω — pour; aor. 3 pl., ε-stem aorist with -α endings (ἔχεα): ’they poured in’
ἕπεο: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., loosely: ’come along, follow’
ἤρτυε: ἀρτύω — fit together, prepare, contrive; impf. 3 sg.: ’was preparing’ (ἐπὶ ... ἤρτυε, tmesis, ’was preparing upon (us)’)
ἴχνι: ἴχνιον — track, footprint; neut. acc. pl., elided (ἴχνι’ = ἴχνια)
ὄφελον: ὀφείλω — owe; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (Attic ὤφελον), with an infinitive, an unattainable wish: ’would that...’
ᾔδεεν: οἶδα — know; plpf. 3 sg., epic -εεν (= Attic ᾔδει): ’had known’
ῥόος: ῥόος — current, stream; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ῥοῦς)
